nodes.title: How to use Â· v2.0.0
widgets_values:
## How to use Â· v2.0.0

**What it does:** changes only one area of a picture (a box, or a mask you paint) from a written instruction with MiniMax H3 Image, on the 12 GB files. Everything outside the area stays the original. Core ComfyUI nodes only.

**One node.** Everything you set is on the big **MiniMax H3 Image (area edit)** node. The picture goes in on the left, the result and the area come out on the right. Double-click the node's title bar to see the inside (the same nodes as v1.0.0).

1. **Your picture** (left): set to `example.png` (ships with ComfyUI); the default box and instruction are written for it, so the first Run works. To paint the area: right-click the picture â†’ **Open in MaskEditor**, paint, Save, and turn **Use my painted mask** on.
2. On the node:
   - **Edit instruction**: what goes in the area. Name the picture as `<Picture 1>`.
   - **Use my painted mask**: off = the box below.
   - **Box left / top / width / height**: in percent of the picture (default 15/0/70/45). Cover the whole old object with room around it.
   - **Megapixels for the edit** (4): the size the model works at. The result keeps your picture's own size.
   - **Seed**: fixed. Type a new number for another take.
   - **Model / Text encoder / VAE**: the three files from the Downloads note.
3. Press **Run**. **Before / after** shows both, **Area that changes** shows the mask; **Result** saves to `output/MiniMax-H3-Image/`.

nodes.title: Downloads + requirements
widgets_values:
## Downloads + requirements

Click the file name to download it. Put each file in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

| Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `diffusion_models/` | [minimax_h3_image_pruned_w4a8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_image_pruned_w4a8.safetensors) | 12.5 GB |
| `text_encoders/` | [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) | 15.7 GB |
| `vae/` | [minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors) | 1.2 GB |

Total 29.4 GB, the same three files for all three workflows in this folder. The text encoder is the same file as for MiniMax H3 video.

**VRAM / RAM:** In a 10 GiB budget the whole GPU peaked at 10.8 to 11.4 GiB (same times, same pictures as without a budget). In a 12 GiB budget ComfyUI took 11.9 to 12.5 GiB. Not verified on a real 12 GB card. System RAM: the ComfyUI process peaked at 20.6 GiB in the 10 GiB budget (16.5 GiB in the 12 GiB one); plan on 32 GB of RAM. 16 GB was not tested.

**Run on ComfyUI 0.45.3.** **No custom nodes** (core nodes only; ComfyUI 0.45+ has the MiniMax H3 Image node).

**Licence:** MiniMax-H3-Image Community License. It does **not** cover use in the EU, the UK, South Korea or the USA. Elsewhere: written permission from MiniMax above 1 million USD yearly revenue or for a hosted service, and a commercial product must show "MiniMax-H3-Image". Read the licence before use. Workflow: MIT.

Why the edit is pasted back
widgets_values: **Why paste back:** MiniMax H3 Image has no mask input, so it edits the whole picture. This group keeps only the area (box or painted mask, with a 31 px soft edge) and puts it into your untouched picture at its own size. Outside the area every pixel stays the original.
